author: akritkbehera
body:
Regenerates the checked-in protobuf gencode in `DQMServices/Core` with `protoc` 6.31.1, as required by the protobuf update in cms-sw/cmsdist#10724 (protobuf 3.21.9  6.31.1, abseil-cpp, grpc 1.35.0  1.82.0, TensorFlow 2.21.0).
  Files regenerated:
  - `DQMServices/Core/interface/ROOTFilePB.pb.h`
  - `DQMServices/Core/src/ROOTFilePB.pb.cc`
title: Regenerate DQMServices/Core protobuf gencode for protobuf 6.31.1
